title: Human Influence Telemetry
description: An open documentary assurance method for evaluating whether human authority retained practical force in AI-mediated institutional decisions. Version 0.6.5 adds claim-evidence mapping, five research-integrity gates, eight negative controls, a paper workspace, and reproducible claim-gate figures while preserving the 0.4.0 normative contract, 0.5.0 conformance engine, bounded 0.6.0 human result, and Level 2 research maturity.
